kids: Hear high school choirs sing carols
Stroll Miracle Mile in the evening
Catch a different choir each night
site: Miracle Mile and Giralda Plaza, downtown Coral Gables
Five evenings in December, 7 to 9 PM
about: The City of Coral Gables lists the carolers as a December program of local high school choirs singing on Miracle Mile and Giralda Plaza.
Student carolers wear festive attire and stroll through downtown from 7 to 9 PM, singing holiday favorites while guests shop, dine and explore.
Friday, December 4 features Miami Senior High School, and Friday, December 11 features Florida Christian School.
Saturday, December 12 features Hialeah Gardens Senior High School, and Friday, December 18 pairs Doral Academy Preparatory with Miami Senior High School.
Saturday, December 19 closes the series with New World School of the Arts and Hialeah Senior High School.
The Coral Gables Economic Development Department sponsors the annual program, and the city marks the listed dates as subject to change.

The first night, December 4, is also the evening of the city's Christmas Tree Lighting at Merrick Park in front of City Hall, 405 Biltmore Way, which starts its show at 5:30 PM with the tree lit at 7 PM.
